id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

properties.description:
A record of properties to be displayed in the form.
Each property contains metadata like description, required status, and possible choices.
The form will render appropriate input fields based on the property type and configuration.

jdbcUrlPrefix.description:
The prefix for the JDBC URL (e.g., "jdbc:mysql://").
This is used to construct and validate the complete JDBC URL.

loading.description:
Whether the form is in a loading state.
When true, displays a loading spinner instead of the form.

informationCardProps.description: Information card props of type InformationCard.propTypes

editMode.description:
Whether the form is in edit mode.
When true, indicates that the user is editing an existing data connector configuration.

editedFields.description:
Fields that have been edited by the user.
Used to track which fields are in an edited state.
Key is the field name, and value is the new value entered by the user.

title: This component renders a form for configuring JDBC connector properties.
name: DataConnectorConfigForm
